rationale: Theta reference fixture (Story 2.1): 10 s, theta reference only, for the engine, reference, frequency, click, and hash probe tests. 450 Hz carrier, amplitude-modulated at 1 Hz by the sawtooth envelope, 75 percent AM depth, the same in both channels.
